pages.title: Environmental Monitor
pages.text: The Environmental Monitor scans the air quality in an 8x8 area around it. Right-click to trigger a scan. It costs $(bold)200 FE$() per scan, so make sure it's powered by a battery first.

pages.title: Reading the Scan
pages.text: After scanning, a colour-coded grid appears on your screen for a few seconds. Each colour shows how polluted that area is — from clean to heavily polluted. Use this to find pollution hotspots and decide where to place Air Scrubbers.
Place it near a Power Bank to keep it charged.
